# dagsterplus_team_all_branch_deployments_grant (Resource)

Manages a permission grant for a Dagster+ team across all branch deployments. If you manage the team with dagsterplus_team, prefer the inline all_branch_deployments_grant block instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_team_all_branch_deployments_grant" "data_eng" {
  team_id = dagsterplus_team.data_engineering.id
  grant   = "EDITOR"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team to grant access.

### Optional

- `custom_role_id` (String) The ID of a custom role to assign. Conflicts with grant.
- `grant` (String) Standard permission level: `VIEWER`, `LAUNCHER`, `EDITOR`, or `ADMIN`. Conflicts with custom_role_id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (the team_id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an all-branch-deployments grant for a team using the team ID.
terraform import dagsterplus_team_all_branch_deployments_grant.example <team_id>
```
